description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a technically strong and motivated Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (F\&O) Engineer who brings hands\-on expertise and a willingness to broaden into adjacent Microsoft technologies such as Power Platform and Azure. This role is ideal for professionals with
 **5\+ years of experience** 
 who are ready to step into a
 **manager\-level capacity** 
 —driving technical support, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to solution delivery while remaining deeply involved in hands\-on work.
   

  

 As part of our India\-based delivery team, you will collaborate closely with global teams to deliver high\-quality support and enhancements across enterprise\-scale Dynamics implementations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Primary Focus – Dynamics 365 F\&O Development \& Support**
* Provide strong, hands\-on support in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues within D365 F\&O environments.
* Contribute to technical design sessions, code development, peer reviews, and deployment planning.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve system defects and data inconsistencies to ensure system stability.
* Support monitoring of system performance and proactively help maintain optimal system health.


**Cross\-Functional Technical Contributions**
* Implement minor\-to\-medium complexity enhancements, bug fixes, and integrations.
* Assist in developing and maintaining integrations leveraging Power Platform, Azure Logic Apps, or related Microsoft cloud services.
* Utilize telemetry, monitoring tools, and analytical insights to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and improve reliability.


**Operational Excellence \& Documentation**
* Own incident resolution workflows, ensuring accurate documentation and timely stakeholder updates.
* Contribute to internal knowledge assets such as SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.
* Support automation initiatives for deployments, environment refreshes, and operational tasks using DevOps practices.


**Expectations**
**Continuous Learning \& Innovation**
* Actively explore new features and capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.
* Participate in knowledge\-sharing sessions, team learning, and cross\-functional collaboration.


**Leadership, Collaboration \& Communication**
* Coordinate effectively with cross\-regional technical and functional teams.
* Communicate confidently with U.S.\-based stakeholders, often during overlapping working hours.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and analysts.
* Explain technical solutions clearly to both technical and non\-technical audience groups.


**Required Skills**
**Mandatory**
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience in Dynamics 365 F\&O (AX/F\&O) technical development and support, including X\+\+, LCS, debugging, and data entity integrations.
* Strong experience identifying and resolving performance, functional, and integration issues across the F\&O stack (SQL DB, AOS, services, SSRS reports).
* Solid proficiency in X\+\+ development, OOP principles, performance optimization, and scalable design.
* Experience with source control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Azure DevOps).
* Strong analytical skills, structured problem\-solving approach, and strong attention to detail.
* Excellent English communication skills with the ability to interface directly with global stakeholders.
* Ability to operate with moderate supervision and take ownership of assigned tasks.
* The ideal candidate must be flexible and willing to work varying shifts between 2:30 PM and 5:30 AM.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with REST/OData services, Dual\-write integrations, and middleware technologies.
* Exposure to monitoring and telemetry tools such as LCS monitoring, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Power BI.
* Familiarity with Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) solutions.
* Basic understanding of Azure architecture components relevant to integrations.


**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

title: Manager - Applications Development - MEAN Stack
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Mercer Tech at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Gurugram. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 As a
 **Lead Software Developer** 
 at Mercer, you will play a key role in shaping our future in the rapidly evolving field of, scalable Shared Services that incorporate AI capabilities. Collaboration is essential, as you will work within a team that follows Scaled Agile methodologies. We are seeking a self\-motivated and delivery\-focused individual with a strong technology background, where experience in AI integrations and prompt engineering will be advantageous, to help us grow our talent and drive innovation in this exciting sector.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Ensure Shared Service requirements are gathered accurately, fully understood, and communicated clearly to all stakeholders, with transparency on impacts and dependencies.
* Design, develop, and support secure, scalable backend and frontend services using Phyton, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
* Implement authentication and security solutions leveraging JWT, SAML/OIDC, Okta integration, Microsoft EntraID and Passport / Passport\-SAML concepts.
* Build and maintain data persistence layers using Postgresql, MongoDB and Mongoose to deliver robust and reliable application functionality.
* Develop automated tests and support quality assurance practices using Jest, NestJS testing patterns, class\-validator, and class\-transformer. Including documentation, and usage guidance to ensure shared services are easy to adopt, maintain, and support.
* Integrate applications using Express, including body\-parser and cookie\-parser, and work effectively with NestJS guards, hooks, modules, and dependency injection.
* Use Git, npm ecosystem, and environment configuration management effectively to support local development, testing, and delivery.
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code aligned to Agile user stories and established engineering standards, while leveraging AI development productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot and resolve development and integration issues, with a focus on performance, authentication, and service interoperability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, serving as a role model and supporting their growth within the team.
* Collaborate with peers to foster a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and engineering excellence.
* Champion Agile practices that support effective product delivery and strong team collaboration.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with product owners, solutions architects, analysts, and leadership to ensure alignment of technical solutions with business objectives.
* Leverage emerging technologies, including AI, to solve real\-world challenges and enhance our software solutions.
* Provide technical support to consumers of the Shared Services for existing issues and recommend enhancements to current solutions.


**What is in it for you?**
* Chance to work on enterprise\-grade shared services used by multiple teams (high visibility and impact).
* Exposure to AI integrations and prompt engineering (advantageous/valued experience).
* Work with modern engineering practices: cloud\-native architecture, CI/CD, DevOps quality gates, security\-first delivery.
* A culture of continuous improvement, learning, and knowledge sharing, with scope to grow as a technical leader.


**What you need to have:**
 We are seeking candidates with a proven track record in developing multiple products/services, ideally those that incorporate AI technologies. The ideal candidate will possess:
   

  

* Shared Services Mindset: Demonstrates a strong focus on building reusable components and services that support multiple teams, reduce duplication, and improve consistency across the platform.
* Strong Communication Skills: Ability to effectively interact with both technical and non\-technical colleagues in a cross\-functional environment.
* Strong Self\-Starter and Team Contributor: A proactive individual who takes initiative in their work, embraces a model of continuous learning to stay updated with industry trends and technologies, and actively contributes to team success by collaborating effectively and sharing knowledge with colleagues.
* Diverse Software Delivery Experience: A successful history of delivering software across a variety of languages, technologies, and platforms, with familiarity in AI frameworks and libraries being a plus.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience with Agile at Scale, Lean, and Continuous Delivery methodologies to drive efficient development processes.
* Cloud\-Native Architecture Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud\-native software architectures, particularly in deploying solutions on platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Azure, with an interest in AI applications.
* Security\-Driven Design Practices: Understanding of security\-driven design principles and experience addressing SAST/DAST findings, especially in relation to AI data handling and model security.
* CI/CD and DevOps Proficiency: Proficiency in CI/CD and DevOps practices, including the use of Quality Gates to ensure high code quality.


**Technical Skills or Qualifications Required:**
* Extensive Programming Experience: Proven experience with multiple programming languages and frameworks, with deep expertise in at least one of the following: JavaScript, TypeScript. Familiarity with AI programming languages such as Python is a plus.
* Framework Proficiency: Strong experience with frameworks such as Nest.js, Express.js, and familiarity with AI frameworks like LangFlow or LangChain.
* Prompt Engineering Skills: Solid experience with engineering prompts to effectively interact with AI models, optimizing their performance and output for various applications.
* Testing Expertise: Proficient in Unit Testing and Integration Testing, including the ability to test AI solutions and their integrations effectively.
* Container Technologies: Experience with container technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, to enhance scalability and efficiency.
* Middleware Technologies: Familiarity with any of these middleware technologies such as Kafka, Camunda, Temporal, AWS Lambda Durable function, AWS Step Function and RabbitMQ is needed.
* Design and Development Practices: Demonstrated experience in refactoring, implementing design patterns, design\-driven development, continuous integration, and application security.
* SDLC Knowledge: Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and practices, with experience using tools such as SharePoint, ADO, and GitHub.
* Cloud Infrastructure Experience: Experience designing and deploying applications/shared services on cloud infrastructure with providers like AWS, including S3 storage.
* Stack Knowledge: Knowledge of the MEAN stack, with an interest in leveraging this technology for AI\-driven applications.
* Senior developer with 7\-11 years of experience in software development, solution design and development, plus delivering high\-quality technical projects/services.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.

title: Service Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
 Ericsson’s Service Architecture team, within Service Management in the Operate Service Line, is building intelligent automation and decision\-support systems for telecom\-scale managed services. In Software Development, you will design, build, test, and ship production\-grade AI services focused on Agentic AI, LLM integrations, vector retrieval, knowledge graph reasoning, and ML infrastructure. Working with platform engineers, data scientists, and product owners, you will turn AI experiments into reliable services that deliver measurable value across Ericsson’s managed service operations.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Google ADK, or equivalent orchestration.
* Build LLM services with prompt engineering, tool/function calling, planning, memory, reflection, guardrails, fallback patterns, and RAG.
* Integrate and evaluate commercial API\-based and open\-source/self\-hosted LLMs, balancing cost, latency, accuracy, privacy, and complexity.
* Build RAG pipelines using ChromaDB, Qdrant, Vertex AI RAG, Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Milvus, or equivalent; manage embeddings, hybrid search, re\-ranking, and index lifecycle.
* Model and query property graphs and RDF/ontologies to enrich agent context, semantic reasoning, and structured retrieval.
* Create evaluation harnesses with automated scoring, human review, A/B testing, and golden datasets.
* Develop ML pipelines for feature engineering, training, evaluation, serving, fine\-tuning, packaging, versioning, and monitoring using Python, PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and HuggingFace.
* Apply ML methods including regression, classification, tree ensembles, boosting, SVMs, neural networks, clustering, PCA/UMAP, LSTMs, and Transformers.
* Monitor model drift, data quality, performance, latency, and token cost in production.
* Build clean, testable Python/PySpark services and REST/FastAPI/Flask/gRPC APIs using clean\-architecture principles.
* Contribute to CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD; participate in reviews, architecture discussions, documentation, runbooks, and mentoring.


**You will bring**
* 6 –15 years of software development experience and a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or equivalent.

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.
   

  

 Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.
   

  

 You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Java
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
   

  

 We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The TeamViewer Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platform finds and resolves IT issues before they affect users. Following the acquisition of 1E, we are bringing our core remote connectivity platform and the DEX platform together into one unified product experience. Our team builds the platform services that connect both worlds — covering authentication \& authorization federation, user synchronization, and secure service\-to\-service communication between the platforms.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong Java (Spring) and Kotlin expertise to play a key role in designing and building these platform integration services, trusted by large enterprise customers. In this role, you’ll work primarily on our core platform, owning and improving the Java\-based services that connect it to the DEX platform.
   

  

 As part of an Agile team, you’ll contribute as an individual contributor, working primarily with Java (Spring) and Kotlin. Your work will power containerized services running on Kubernetes. As the DEX platform is built on .NET, familiarity with C\# services is a welcome plus. You will be joining a young, motivated team and will play an active role in mentoring and guiding its members in best practices in software development \& Secure SDLC.
   

  

* Develop \& enhance platform services that connect our core remote connectivity platform and the DEX platform, in the areas of authentication \& authorization federation, user synchronization, and cross\-platform service\-to\-service communication
* Define the architecture, design and develop new features for our platform services in Java (Spring) and Kotlin
* Work with identity and access concepts such as token exchange, service principals, user\-context authentication, and auditing across platform boundaries
* Continuously integrate, build and deploy our solution from test system to production
* Design and implement secure, well\-documented APIs based on architecture guidelines and frameworks
* Design and build common database systems of high availability and quality
* Optimize and enhance our software with new, efficient algorithms and state\-of\-the\-art software tools and technologies
* Work independently on solutions for specified requirements and be responsible for complying with time and quality specifications
* Ensure that our software is secure, stable, scalable and runs efficiently
* Monitor the latest technical developments in your field and make proposals for improvement
* Guide and assist other team members in engineering topics relevant for the team
* Coach \& mentor junior members of a young and growing team, fostering a culture of quality, ownership and continuous learning
* Act as an advisor for product owners (feasibility studies and time estimates for new functionality to be implemented)
* Collaborate closely with the teams owning the DEX platform to align on interfaces, contracts and integration flows


**Requirements**
* A university degree in the field of information technology, computer science and engineering or a related subject
* 7\+ years of professional experience in the field of software development
* Solid knowledge of Java (Spring), Kotlin and SQL is mandatory
* Solid understanding of authentication \& authorization concepts (e.g. OAuth2/OIDC, token exchange, service\-to\-service and user\-context authentication)
* Hands on experience with cloud services (like managed Kubernetes, Redis, key vaults, message brokers, PostgreSQL etc), docker containers and CI/CD pipelines
* Must have hands on experience in Docker \& Kubernetes ecosystem and should be able to work on them locally in docker desktop.
* Must have experience in any of the unit test casing framework
* Experience in taking architectural decisions about the development and maintenance of large\-scale distributed systems and integrations between platforms and services
* Solid knowledge of Secure SDLC principles, OWASP Top\-10 vulnerabilities \& remediation, and Threat Modeling
* Experience in quick feasibility studies, POC \& prototyping to arrive at firm estimates
* Understanding of Clean Code and Design Patterns for object\-orientated programming
* Proven ability and willingness to mentor and coach junior engineers, paired with strong communication skills
* A positive and solution\-oriented mindset paired with a structured and analytical way of thinking/working, being a team player, as well as motivated to learn new things
* Knowledge of .NET (C\#) backend services is a plus (the DEX platform is built on .NET)
* Experience in any of the following is desirable: parallel programming (multi\-threading), test automation, network communications, digital certificates/PKI
* Familiarity with AI tools for coding (like Co\-pilot) is a plus


 TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C\-A\-R\-E and understand that our diverse, values\-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description:
**Associate Software Engineer (Backend) — Digital Platform \& Engineering** 




**Location:** 
 Noida (work from office, 5 days a week)
 



**Experience:** 
 1–2 years
 



**Team:** 
 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE)
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Engineering Manager, DPE
 



  





**Who we are** 




 Over the past 17 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world\-class multi\-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Noida, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cyber City \& Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta continues to expand its healthcare ecosystem through diagnostics, pharmacies, homecare services and digital health initiatives.
 



 Digital Platform \& Engineering (DPE) is Medanta's newly built product and technology organization. Modelled on India's leading internet companies, DPE brings together product managers, designers and engineers to build the products and platforms that power patient journeys, clinical care and hospital operations across the Medanta network. We work from our own office in Noida, with strong sponsorship from the CEO and the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for Associate Software Engineers with strong computer science fundamentals and early hands\-on experience of how real software gets built, reviewed and shipped. You will build backend services and APIs that doctors, nurses and patients rely on every day.
 



 This is a role for engineers who want to learn fast in a small, high\-calibre team. You will work alongside experienced engineering managers and senior engineers, with engineering levels and practices modelled on India's top product companies. We move with startup energy, but in healthcare quality is non\-negotiable, so you will learn to build software that is fast to ship and safe to trust.
 



  





**What You Will Work On** 



* **Seamless patient journeys** 
 — the services behind finding the right doctor, booking a visit, diagnostics, payments, discharge and follow\-up across OPD, IPD, emergency and day care.
* **Products that empower clinicians and caregivers** 
 — technology that assists doctors, nurses and care teams managing heavy patient loads.
* **Platform\-first foundations** 
 — reusable services such as payments, care subscriptions, scheduling and a unified patient record, designed once and used by every product across the network.
* **Voice\-first, touch\-first and AI\-first experiences** 
 — backends for products where people speak instead of type, tap instead of filling forms, and are assisted by AI at every step.
* **A Hospital Information System built from scratch** 
 — the core clinical platform, including EMR, that runs every hospital workflow.
* **Intelligence and interoperability** 
 — AI\-powered services, healthcare data platforms, and integrations with national digital health standards such as ABDM and FHIR.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, build, test and ship backend services and APIs in Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI), with guidance from senior engineers.
* Write clean, well\-tested and maintainable code; take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
* Understand the components of the systems you work on — databases, caches such as Redis, message queues such as Kafka — and why each is used.
* Model data and write efficient queries on relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Debug and fix issues across development and production, and contribute to monitoring and reliability.
* Work closely with product managers, designers and senior engineers to understand requirements and the clinical workflows behind them, including occasional visits to our hospitals.
* Ask questions, think independently, and constructively challenge designs when something does not add up.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents throughout development — planning, implementing, testing and refactoring — while owning every line you ship, whether you or an AI wrote it.
* Follow secure coding and data\-privacy practices for systems that handle patient data — audit trails, role\-based access control and encryption of sensitive data, in line with regulations such as the DPDP Act — and strict guardrails so patient information is never exposed to unapproved AI tools.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




***Must have***



* 1–2 years of software development experience at a product company, startup or technology services company, with exposure to a real development workflow — version control, code reviews, testing and deployments.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented programming, databases, and operating systems and networking basics.
* Proficiency in Java or Python.
* Hands\-on use of AI coding assistants and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) in day\-to\-day development — writing effective prompts, breaking tasks down for an agent, and rigorously reviewing and testing what it produces.
* A clear understanding of the project you currently work on — its design, the components used, and the reasons behind those choices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to explain your thinking clearly while solving a problem.
* Good written and verbal communication.
* A builder's mindset: excited to build from the ground up, comfortable with ambiguity, and keen to take ownership.
* A product mindset — curiosity about how hospitals work, and care for the outcome for the user, not just the ticket.
* Depth over frequent switches — we value engineers who have stayed long enough in a role to learn from it.



***Good to have***



* Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI.
* Exposure to Redis, Kafka, or other caching and messaging systems.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Internships, open\-source contributions, or side projects that have been used by real users.
* Personal or internship projects that use LLM APIs or build simple agents.
* Competitive programming experience.
* Exposure to frontend development (React).



  





**Education** 



* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or a related field from a top\-tier institution (IITs, IIITs, NITs, BITS or equivalent).



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Build from the ground up — a Hospital Information System, shared platforms, and voice\-first and AI\-first products — at the scale of one of India's leading hospital networks.
* Learn in a small, flat, high\-calibre team, with close access to engineering leadership and the Chief Digital Officer.
* An engineering bar and career ladder modelled on India's top product companies, with a clear path for growth.
* See your code used by doctors, nurses and patients — and work alongside some of India's most respected clinicians.
* Access to the latest AI coding tools, and a team that is rethinking how software gets built.
* A tech\-first culture: our own office, a flat and informal environment, and open\-door leadership.
* The energy of a startup with the stability of a profitable, publicly listed healthcare group.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Java Full Stack Technical Lead, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should be hands\-on in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. Along with independent technical contribution, the role requires mentoring junior engineers in the team, guiding implementation decisions, reviewing code, ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* The Java Full Stack Technical Lead will be responsible for independently leading product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on and technically strong enough to contribute as an individual contributor while also providing technical leadership, design direction, code reviews, and guidance to the team.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 10\+ years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer- Java/AI
description:
**Why UKG**
 At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
   

  

 We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an accomplished Sr. Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for highly scalable, reliable, secure, and business\-critical payroll and compliance solutions.
   

  

 This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer with deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a proven ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and domains. You will serve as a go\-to technical expert, solving some of our most challenging engineering problems while influencing architecture, engineering strategy, and technical standards across the Value Stream.
   

  

 As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the strategy, architecture, and execution of large\-scale technical initiatives with significant complexity, dependencies, and customer impact. You will identify emerging technologies and engineering practices, evaluate their applicability to our platforms, and translate them into scalable solutions that improve customer experience, engineering productivity, reliability, and long\-term platform capabilities.
   

  

 We are looking for a technical leader with an AI\-first mindset and unified engineering approach who takes end\-to\-end ownership — from understanding customer and business needs through architecture, development, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, architecture, compliance, operations, and senior leaders while mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction across teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Technical Leadership \& Architecture
   

  

* Serve as a subject matter expert and trusted technical advisor for complex systems, architecture, and engineering challenges.
* Lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of large\-scale, cross\-domain software systems and platform capabilities supporting payroll, compliance, and enterprise applications.
* Develop technical strategies for initiatives with substantial complexity, integration requirements, risk, and customer impact.
* Drive architectural decisions that improve scalability, reliability, maintainability, security, performance, and operational efficiency.
* Apply deep technical expertise and advanced engineering principles to solve unique and complex problems affecting multiple teams or capabilities.
* Evaluate architectural trade\-offs and technology choices while balancing immediate business requirements with long\-term platform strategy.
* Partner with architects, engineering leaders, product leaders, and other stakeholders to evolve platform architecture and technical roadmaps.
* Anticipate emerging technical challenges and identify opportunities to introduce new technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering practices.
* Influence architectural standards and engineering decisions across the Value Stream.


 Software Development
   

  

* Drive the development strategy for large\-scale, complex, and cross\-domain modules, services, and sub\-systems.
* Design and develop highly scalable backend APIs, distributed systems, cloud\-native services, and high\-volume data processing capabilities.
* Deliver high\-quality, maintainable, secure, testable, and observable software using modern engineering practices.
* Establish and reinforce best practices for software design, coding, testing, performance, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Lead strategic code, design, and test\-plan reviews and raise the engineering quality bar across teams.
* Drive modernization and technical\-debt reduction initiatives that improve platform sustainability, developer productivity, and customer experience.
* Remain hands\-on with critical technical challenges, prototypes, complex implementations, and production problems where deep expertise is required.


 AI\-First Engineering \& Innovation
   

  

* Champion an AI\-first engineering culture and drive effective and responsible adoption of AI across engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to use AI across requirements analysis, architecture, software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, observability, and operational workflows.
* Evaluate emerging capabilities in Generative AI, AI\-assisted software development, agentic systems, and intelligent automation and determine their applicability to business and engineering challenges.
* Lead proofs of concept and technical experiments that translate emerging AI capabilities into practical engineering solutions.
* Develop reusable AI\-enabled tools, patterns, or practices that can scale beyond an individual team.
* Measure the impact of AI initiatives through outcomes such as engineering effort saved, cycle\-time improvement, automation gains, quality improvement, or reduction in


 operational effort.
   

  

* Mentor engineers on effective, secure, and responsible use of AI throughout the SDLC.
* Stay current with emerging AI and technology trends and provide technical recommendations on where engineering practices and architecture should evolve.


 Reliability, Observability \& Incident Leadership
   

  

* Take ownership of the health, reliability, scalability, observability, and production readiness of business\-critical services.
* Actively participate in production support and on\-call responsibilities and provide technical leadership during complex incidents.
* Lead incident response across services, coordinating investigation, mitigation, communication, recovery, and follow\-up actions.
* Lead root cause analysis for significant production incidents and drive systemic corrective and preventive actions.
* Establish and champion observability practices using telemetry, metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerting.
* Identify recurring failure patterns and drive architectural or engineering improvements that prevent customer impact.
* Partner with SRE, platform, and engineering teams to improve operational maturity and system resiliency.
* Influence service\-health and reliability practices beyond the immediate team.


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Ensure architecture and applications adhere to secure coding practices, privacy requirements, and applicable compliance standards.
* Drive secure handling of payroll, tax, financial, and personally identifiable information (PII).
* Incorporate security, privacy, auditability, and data\-governance considerations into architecture and technical design from the beginning.
* Identify security and compliance risks associated with architectural and technology decisions and drive appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Advocate for security\-by\-design and privacy\-by\-design principles throughout the software development lifecycle.


 Technical Strategy \& Continuous Engineering
   

  

* Understand product, engineering, and business strategy and translate strategic objectives into technical direction and execution.
* Identify emerging technology trends and evaluate how they can improve products, platforms, engineering practices, or customer outcomes.
* Develop advanced technical ideas and guide them from experimentation through adoption and production implementation.
* Anticipate significant technical and business challenges and develop solutions aligned with long\-range objectives.
* Champion new tools, technologies, and engineering practices and help scale successful approaches across teams.
* Articulate trade\-offs between short\-term technical solutions and long\-term architectural sustainability, ensuring risks are clearly understood by stakeholders.
* Influence prioritization of technical investments based on customer impact, operational risk, engineering efficiency, and long\-term platform health.


 Mentorship \& Engineering Excellence
   

  

* Act as a technical mentor and role model for engineers across multiple experience levels.
* Mentor engineers through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and technical decision\-making.
* Help develop senior engineers into stronger technical leaders and independent problem solvers.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, accountability, collaboration, and engineering excellence.
* Lead architecture and technical knowledge\-sharing sessions and ensure important architectural decisions and learnings are documented.
* Build technical communities and relationships across teams to promote reuse of engineering patterns, knowledge, and best practices.
* Participate in technical interviews and help maintain a high engineering hiring bar.
* Provide clear, evidence\-based hiring feedback and help other engineers improve their interviewing capabilities.


 Unified Engineering Ownership
   

  

* Demonstrate end\-to\-end ownership across requirements, architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement.
* Lead large initiatives, programs, or multiple projects with substantial technical risk, complexity, integration requirements, and organizational visibility.
* Develop execution strategies for broadly defined outcomes and independently determine technical objectives, approaches, and methods.
* Identify cross\-team dependencies and risks early and drive alignment and resolution.
* Influence technical execution across multiple teams without relying on formal authority.
* Partner with Product, Architecture, Compliance, Customer Support, SRE, and other engineering teams to deliver customer\-focused solutions.
* Establish accountability and engineering ownership throughout the lifecycle of capabilities being delivered.


 Customer \& Business Mindset
   

  

* Develop deep understanding of the business domain and how customers use the capabilities and systems being designed.
* Connect architecture and engineering decisions to customer experience, business outcomes, reliability, compliance, and operational impact.
* Partner with Product and business stakeholders to understand customer problems and help shape technical solutions and capability direction.
* Use telemetry, product analytics, monitoring, operational data, and customer feedback to understand how capabilities behave in production.
* Anticipate customer impact when introducing architectural changes, new capabilities, migrations, or technology transformations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor on complex customer and business challenges.
* Ensure monitoring, telemetry, and operational readiness are considered from the beginning of solution design rather than after deployment.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
* 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and leading complex enterprise software systems.
* Deep expertise in Java and/or Python development.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering scalable backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of distributed\-system architecture, design patterns, scalability, resiliency, concurrency, performance, and data consistency.
* Strong SQL and data\-modeling experience.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
* Experience with distributed caching technologies such as Redis and/or Hazelcast.
* Strong experience with observability platforms including Grafana, Kibana, OpenTelemetry, or similar technologies.
* Proven ability to lead large, technically complex initiatives involving multiple teams, services, or domains.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technical strategy and translate broadly defined business outcomes into executable technical solutions.
* Proven experience leading resolution of complex production incidents and driving root cause analysis and preventive improvements.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, production operations, and service ownership.
* Strong understanding of secure software development and handling of sensitive customer data.
* Demonstrated AI\-first engineering mindset with hands\-on experience applying AI\-assisted development tools and workflows to real engineering problems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and influence technical decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Strong customer and business mindset with the ability to connect technical decisions to customer and organizational outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts, influence stakeholders, and build alignment across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently and exercise sound technical judgment in ambiguous and highly complex situations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in payroll, tax, HR, fintech, compliance, financial systems, or other highly regulated domains.
* Strong understanding of U.S. and/or Canadian payroll processing concepts.
* Experience architecting high\-volume, high\-availability transaction processing systems.
* Experience designing and evolving cloud\-native microservices and distributed architectures at enterprise scale.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, deployment architecture, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience leading major architectural transformations, platform modernization, or complex system migrations.

* Experience driving adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices and demonstrating measurable improvements in engineering productivity or quality.

* Demonstrated technical thought leadership through architecture forums, technical publications, internal engineering communities, patents, conference participation, or similar contributions.

title: SAP BW HANA ABAP
description:
Job Description
 



**Job Title: SAP BW / HANA / ABAP Developer** 




**Location: Remote** 




  





 Position summary
 



 We are looking for a strong SAP BW/HANA Developer with deep, hands\-on expertise across BW/BW4HANA data modelling, native SAP HANA development, and ABAP/ABAP\-on\-HANA programming. This role demands core technical strength — not surface familiarity — in all four pillars: BW, HANA, ABAP, and HANA SQL. The ideal candidate can independently design data models, write performant HANA SQL/SQLScript, and build custom ABAP logic across the data layer.
 



 Core Skills — Must Be Strong
 



 • SAP BW / BW4HANA — data modelling, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, transformations, process chains, query design.
 



 • SAP HANA — calculation views (graphical \& script\-based), analytic/attribute views, modelling best practices.
 



 • ABAP — core ABAP development, OOABAP, and ABAP on HANA (code pushdown, AMDP).
 



 • HANA SQL / SQLScript — advanced query writing, performance tuning, stored procedures, table functions.
 



 Candidates should be able to speak to real project depth in each of these four areas, not just one or two — this is a strong\-hands\-on\-all\-round profile, not a specialist in a single tool.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Design, build, and optimize BW/BW4HANA data models (ADSO, CompositeProvider, Open ODS View, InfoObjects).
 



 • Develop calculation views, analytic views, and complex SQLScript\-based logic in native HANA.
 



 • Write and maintain ABAP programs, function modules, and AMDP\-based transformation routines.
 



 • Tune HANA SQL queries and data models for performance — partitioning, indexing, and execution plan analysis.
 



 • Build and maintain DTPs, transformation rules, and process chains for reliable, monitored data loads.
 



 • Integrate BW/HANA outputs with reporting layers (BEx, SAP Analytics Cloud, or equivalent BI tools).
 



 • Troubleshoot data load failures, performance bottlenecks, and data reconciliation issues across the BW/HANA stack.
 



 • Collaborate with functional teams to translate business/reporting requirements into technical data models.
 



 • Document technical designs, data models, and transformation logic; support testing and go\-live activities.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 Experience
 



 • 5\-8\+ years of overall SAP experience, with strong hands\-on exposure to BW/BW4HANA, native HANA modelling, and ABAP.
 



 • Demonstrated project experience writing HANA SQL/SQLScript for performance\-critical data logic.
 



 • Experience with ABAP on HANA — code pushdown techniques, AMDP, and HANA\-optimized ABAP.
 



 Technical Skills
 



 • Strong command of BW LSA/LSA\+\+ architecture, InfoObjects, transformations, and process chain monitoring.
 



 • Hands\-on HANA modelling: calculation views (graphical and SQLScript\-based), analytic/attribute views.
 



 • Proficient in Core ABAP, OOABAP, and debugging complex custom developments.
 



 • Strong SQL fundamentals with the ability to write and tune complex HANA SQL queries and stored procedures.
 



 • Familiarity with SAP source system extraction (ECC/S4HANA) and RFC\-based connections.
 



 Education
 



 • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
 



 Good to Have
 



 • Exposure to SAP Datasphere or SAP BW/4HANA migration/conversion projects.
 



 • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) or other BI/reporting tool integration.
 



 • Knowledge of SAP BTP and OData\-based data consumption.
 



 • Exposure to S/4HANA data structures (Universal Journal / ACDOCA) is a plus.
 



 Preferred Certifications
 



 • SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP BW/4HANA
 



 • SAP Certified Development Associate — ABAP with SAP HANA
 



 • SAP Certified Technology Associate — SAP HANA
 



 Soft Skills \& Attributes
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward performance and data accuracy.
 



 • Able to work independently on complex technical builds with minimal hand\-holding.
 



 • Good communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration with business and BI teams.
 



 • Comfortable in Agile/Scrum delivery environments handling multiple concurrent workstreams.

**Job Overview**
 The Salesforce Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.
   

  

 The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version\-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.
   

  

 Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow.
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling.
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies.
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies.
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk.
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice.
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high\-quality, scalable solutions.
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards.
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO.
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce\-related Service Desk tickets.
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance.
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed.
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery.
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices.


**About You**
* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience.
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable.
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required.
* Strong hands\-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies.
* Practical Salesforce administration experience including users, permissions, security, objects, fields, configuration and Flow.
* Experience working with integrations and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP.
* Experience using Git and working within a structured deployment or CI/CD process.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable technical or administrative activities.
* Strong engineering and problem\-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.
* Data management and relational database knowledge, including data formats, joins and ETL concepts.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce development, deployment and platform best practices.
